items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: And Harrison Burrett, myself. And Eddie Pearson, yeah, to come play, to play at the American Legion Hall. So, so we played there.

ctx.x: Do you still play the same number of jobs you had when Popper was alive, or do you find that the work is getting less and less?

No, they got less. They got less. Yeah, they got less, yes. Now, after Popper died and Eddie taking over, we've done almost as much as with Popper had. Yeah? With Eddie? Yeah, with Eddie Pearson. And after he died, well, it looked like it sliced up a little bit more then, you see. And so...
Are you still playing for the boat when the boat leaves every two weeks?
